main.description: A photo approved for use in one wiki, stored in the wiki owner's repo (which also holds the blob). The rkey is a TID. When a wiki's policy sets imageMode 'approved', contributors may only embed images listed here.

wikiRef.description: AT-URI of the wiki the media belongs to.

imageCid.description: CID of the blob in the wiki owner's repo, as referenced by markdown image embeds (blob:CID).

blob.description: The blob reference itself, so the record keeps the image fetchable.

addedBy.description: DID of the account the image came from — the owner, or the contributor whose submission was approved.

source.description: 'owner' when the wiki owner uploaded it directly; 'submission' when it arrived through a wiki.pckt.suggestion photo submission.
